About ETB Technologies

Founded in 2001 we are a leading supplier of refurbished servers, storage and network equipment, providing complete units and component parts to customers worldwide.

We carry one of the largest stocks of Dell EMC Enterprise level complete units and spare parts in the world - ready for same day shipping to any destination. The current product range includes Dell EMC PowerEdge servers, Dell EMC PowerConnect, Force10, S and N-Series switches, Dell EMC PowerVault MD series storage arrays, Dell EMC PowerVault tape drives and libraries, Compellent and EqualLogic storage arrays.

We also offer an extensive range of networking solutions, storage arrays, hard drives and spares from Cisco, HP, Juniper and NetApp.

Any of our servers or SAN’s can be configured to your requirements, usually from in-house stock. All refurbished equipment is covered by our own warranty, and technical support is available from our engineers.

Accepted Payment Methods

We accept payment by PayPal, Google Pay, Apple Pay, Credit or Debit Card and Bank Transfer.

Schools & Educational Organisations

We accept purchase orders from Schools and other Educational organisations. Please contact us HERE. Our full business information can be found at the bottom of this page under Business seller information

Tax Information

International Orders
UK VAT will be excluded on International orders.
Please contact us before purchase if you have any questions.

All export customers are responsible for customs clearance and the payment of any import taxes and fees. Please contact us before purchasing if you have any questions regarding this.

Shipping via courier from UK Mainland

Dispatch Times:

We aim to dispatch all orders placed before 2pm on the day of receipt. Items that require a build and configuration such as servers and storage arrays may take an extra 24 hours before shipping. We will keep you informed of any changes to the dispatch times quoted.

UK Shipping Times:

All UK parcel shipments are sent using a next day courier service and are normally delivered the next working day (Monday to Friday excluding UK Bank Holidays). Larger items that require shipping on a pallet are sent via a freight service which takes 1-2 days for delivery.

USA and Rest of World Deliveries:

All deliveries outside of the UK are shipped with an international economy courier service normally FedEx or DHL. For an estimate of shipping times on overseas purchases please contact us using the Ask Seller a Question feature on eBay or use the shipping tool on ebay.

We may on occasion use alternative couriers to deliver your order. This will be on the same service levels as above and we will let you know tracking details for the order when it has shipped.

We make every effort to ensure that goods are delivered on time, however we cannot be held responsible for delays once your order has been handed to the courier.

We are experienced in shipping goods worldwide. Orders shipping outside of the UK may require some additional information from you to allow us to complete customs paperwork. Not providing this information when requested may incur delays in customs processing. Overseas deliveries may be subject to local import taxes or duties, which the customer shall be liable for.

If you have any special requests regarding deliveries then please contact us using the Ask Seller a question feature on eBay and we'll be happy to help.

EIN Numbers

Customers based in the USA may require an EIN or SSN to import goods purchased from the UK. This rule is for businesses and individuals alike.

For more information, contact us. Placing an order without providing your EIN or SSN number could result in a shipping delay.

All items are sold with the balance of manufacturer warranty or ETB return to base warranty unless otherwise stated.

Unwanted items may be returned within 14 working days of the date that the goods are received. Goods are returned at the customers cost.

All damaged items must be notified within 24 hours of delivery.

All returns should be shipped using packaging that will afford the item suitable protection whilst in the hands of the courier/postal service.
